contents.label: Elevated: 1994 Season Edition
contents.about: Every Elevated feature, including Fixed Fatigue and the original-game fixes, with all 107 I-A teams of 1994, their rosters and conferences, the real 1994 schedule and the 19 bowls. 4 MB ROM, 32 KB save RAM.

contents.label: Elevated: 2026 Season Edition
contents.about: Every Elevated feature, including Fixed Fatigue and the original-game fixes, plus all 138 FBS teams with 2026 rosters and conferences, conference title games, the playoff and the 2026 clock and overtime rules. 4 MB ROM, 32 KB save RAM.

contents.label: Fatigue fix and bug fixes
contents.about: Only the fatigue fix and fixes for the original game's bugs: the 2-point conversion kickoff, pitches to fast backs and the season sim. No other gameplay changes. Original teams, 1994 rosters and title screen.

contents.label: Fatigue only
contents.about: Only the fatigue fix (or no fatigue). No other gameplay changes. Original teams, 1994 rosters and title screen.

fatigue.label: Fixed Fatigue
fatigue.about: Recommended. Every player tires from what he does on the field and recovers between plays.

fatigue.label: No Fatigue
fatigue.about: Energy never drops. Nothing else changes: the original game with 1994 rosters and no other gameplay changes.
